item.title: Encode Decimal as str, not float
item.content: In flask.json's JSONEncoder.default, serialize decimal.Decimal by returning str(o) (grouped with uuid.UUID), never float, to avoid losing precision.

review_comments: how about 0.03 instead of 100? :)
fyi django cast decimal to str instead of float https://github.com/django/django/blob/225d96533a8e05debd402a2bfe566487cc27d95f/django/core/serializers/json.py#L103

I would prefer to call the json encoder in the normal way:

```python 
    rv = flask.json.dumps(decimal.Decimal(0.003))
    assert rv == '0.003'
```
Thief said "not int" not "float". It should definitely be str, that's the only way to not lose precision (at the expense of losing the number type).
